channel.title: Security Council Resolution 1718 (2006)
channel.description: Tracking Security Council resolution 1718 and the follow-up sanctions resolutions on the DPRK.

item.title: 1718 Committee Panel of Experts: mandate ends
item.description: The mandate of the Panel of Experts assisting the 1718 Committee came to an end, as the renewal proposed in March 2024 was not adopted by the Security Council.

item.title: Resolution 2397 (2017)
item.description: The Council tightens sanctions on the DPRK, notably on refined petroleum products and crude oil.

item.title: Resolution 2375 (2017)
item.description: New measures adopted after the nuclear test of 3 September 2017.

item.title: Resolution 2270 (2016)
item.description: Sanctions strengthened after the nuclear test of January 2016.

item.title: Resolution 1874 (2009)
item.description: The Council toughens sanctions after the DPRK's second nuclear test and establishes the Panel of Experts.

item.title: Adoption of resolution 1718
item.description: The Security Council adopts sanctions against the DPRK following the nuclear test of 9 October 2006 and establishes the 1718 Committee.
